entities.name: Arabidopsis eS8z
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana UniProt Q93VG5; 222 aa.
Annotated as a small ribosomal subunit protein; structural constituent of ribosome and mRNA binding.
Associated with cytoplasmic translation; annotations include cytosolic small ribosomal subunit, nucleolus, and chloroplast.
Other recorded localizations (cell wall, plasmodesma) are annotation evidence but do not alone establish a primary site.

entities.name: Cytoplasmic translation
observations: The exact-match reference protein Q93VG5 has a GO annotation for cytoplasmic translation.

entities.name: Cytosolic small ribosome
observations: The exact-match reference annotates the protein to the cytosolic small ribosomal subunit.
